title: Read and show the did:key entries of a verified did:webvh log (decision mimid-1wgh.97)
description:
Implements decision mimid-1wgh.97. No credential, codec or verifier change is needed: mimi_user_uri already ignores every alsoKnownAs entry that is not the one 'mimi:' URI, so a did:key entry passes verification unread today.

WORK.
- A reader in mimi-mls beside mimi_user_uri for the did:key entries of a VerifiedLog's head document. Unlike the mimi: URI, which is one or none, a person may publish several keys, so it returns all of them in document order and does not refuse a log for having many. Non-string entries are skipped as head_also_known_as already skips them.
- Keep it on the Person record beside did, so a front end can show it without re-verifying a log.
- Show it: WHOIS 320 gains an 'AKA did:key:...' line, which is meshIRCd's own shape for alsoKnownAs (its IDENTITY.md); the IRC service's 'identity <user>' command lists them; METADATA's identity value can carry them beside id once the shape question of mimid-i0id.11 is settled.

WHY IT MATTERS: it is what makes a person present on meshIRCd and in a MIMI room recognisably one person, which is the whole point of the shared identity story. The did:key carries no MLS authority and the display must not imply it does.
